> [!abstract] Summary
> Mira Vale serves as the keeper of the archive situated beneath the eastern observatory. She maintains the integrity of the collection and manages the arrival of visitors at dawn. Her current focus is the preservation of the archive's contents, specifically the restoration of damaged tide charts before the arrival of spring ships.

## Backstory
Mira Vale holds the position of keeper for the archive located under the eastern observatory. Her routine is defined by the preservation of the site, beginning each day at dawn when she inspects the copper locks to ensure the security of the records. She manages the regular influx of information, including the sealed records delivered by [[02 Character/Orin Sable|Orin Sable]] every third day.

## Abilities
Mira demonstrates a methodical approach to archival maintenance and security. She is responsible for the physical security of the archive, specifically the checking of the copper locks. She possesses the practical knowledge required to manage the archive's intake of sealed records and the logistical awareness to prioritize repairs on essential documents like the tide charts.

## Goals
Mira is driven by the need to restore the damaged tide charts. This repair is a priority for her, as the charts must be functional before the spring ships arrive.

## Key Scenes
* Mira checks the copper locks of the archive while Orin waits outside with a sealed record.
* Mira expresses the urgency of repairing the tide charts before the spring ships arrive.

## Appearance
Evidence is insufficient.
